resources.string: NexLink Social is invite only. There is no sign-up form — someone already using it has to invite you.\n\nEnter the code they sent you.
Twelve characters. Capitals and numbers only. Hyphens and spaces don\'t matter.
Invite codes never contain the letter U. Check the code again.

NexLink Social is a private messaging and calling app.

Your messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted. That means they are scrambled on your phone and can only be unscrambled by the people you are talking to.

It is invite only, so it stays small.

It is run by one person, not a company. There is no support team and no service guarantee. It is offered as-is.
What we can and cannot see

The content of your messages
The content of your calls
Your photos and files
Your message history

Who you message, and when
How often, and roughly how much
Your IP address
Which devices you use
We are telling you the right-hand column because it is true. Any app that tells you it can see nothing at all is not being straight with you.
Your messages live on your phone

Your message history is stored on this device. That is the real copy.

The server keeps an encrypted copy so that a new device can catch up — but the server cannot read it, and neither can we.

If you lose this phone and have no way back in, your history is gone. Not withheld — gone. We cannot recover it for you, because we have never been able to read it.

The next steps set up your way back in. Take them seriously.

You can also move everything directly to a new phone when you replace this one.
